Container.Name: designcraft-web
Container.Overview: DesignCraft Web is a community-maintained Docker image that serves DesignCraft, a page layout and publishing design application, through a browser-based WebAssembly interface. It provides a self-hosted way to access the upstream design editor from a modern browser. The container only serves the static web application through NGINX; it does not provide a remote Linux desktop or a server-side design backend.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: DesignCraft Design Craft Page Layout Publishing Desktop Publishing Graphic Design Layout Editor Browser WebAssembly WASM
Container.Requires: No special privileges, database, or persistent data volumes are required for the standard deployment. The application runs in the browser and uses browser capabilities for graphics and local file handling. The container serves HTTP on port 8080. Use HTTPS through a reverse proxy such as Traefik for remote access; browser graphics features may require a secure context.

Config.Name: HTTP Port
Config.Description: Host port used to access the DesignCraft Web interface. The container listens on port 8080.
